sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases star elemental attack by 8 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Deals 40% of current HP as damage. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies hero for 60 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies debuffs, status ailments, and Unison gauge reduction; nullifies buffs [Demerit]; reduces healing effects received by 70% [Demerit]).
-Applies Star Element to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8500
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8500
